mandat.keinParlament: This proposal requires an elected parliament.
mandat.offenGrund: Parliament is already debating this proposal.
mandat.pause: Wait 14 days after withdrawal or failure before introducing a new proposal.
mandat.eingebracht: “{name}” introduced. The vote is in seven days; negotiate compromises before then.
mandat.nichtOffen: This negotiation is no longer available or has already taken place.
mandat.widerspruch: These conditions conflict. Remove the opposing clause first.
mandat.keinEinsatz: An operational guarantee requires an active war or ceasefire.
mandat.geaendert: Draft amended. All factions reassess the entire package; at least three days remain for debate.
mandat.gesprochen: Policy talks with {partei}: more votes for this proposal, no permanent allegiance.
mandat.zurueckgezogen: Proposal withdrawn. Half the introduction capital, rounded down, is refunded; negotiation costs remain spent.
mandat.gegenstandslos: “{name}” cannot be enacted: {grund} Political capital remains spent; no budget or supply order is issued.
mandat.angenommen: Parliament passes “{name}” with {ja} votes in favour. The agreed conditions bind the programme.
mandat.abgelehnt: “{name}” fails with {ja} votes in favour. No programme; political capital remains spent. Government trust −0.5, approval −0.4.
mandat.altauftrag: Existing government mandate: remains in force under its original conditions.
mandat.stand: {ja} of {gesamt} seats support the proposal; 301 votes are required.
mandat.termin: Vote on {datum}, automatically when the day advances. Amendments and talks can change the majority.
mandat.vorEinbringen: Preliminary support. After introduction, seven days remain for negotiation; only a successful vote funds the programme.
mandat.gegenstandslosHilfe: Requirements were no longer met on voting day. The decision log contains the reason.
mandat.stimmenHilfe: Votes per faction, not guaranteed pledges. Seats, ideology, coalition, toleration, willingness and the whole package matter. Talks add up to six percent of faction seats. The vote uses the situation on voting day, with no additional random roll.
mandat.kompromissHilfe: Each clause applies to the whole programme. Social compensation excludes the budget cap; civilian priority excludes the operational guarantee. Winning one faction can alienate another.
mandat.konditionen: If passed: {bip}% of GDP once · {vorlauf} days preparation · then {dauer} days in force.
mandat.tagesordnungHilfe: Negotiate the same proposals as in the economy dossier. Both views share votes and agreements.
mandat.sozial.text: Additional 0.03% GDP. Poverty −0.25 per monthly settlement while active; the austerity package’s trust penalty falls from 0.25 to 0.10. Creates no additional goods. With several programmes, this compensation applies only once per month.
mandat.haushalt.text: Base budget −35%, duration halved. Monthly deliveries and repairs remain unchanged; support ends earlier. Extension requires a new vote.
mandat.kontrolle.text: Seven additional preparation days. Monthly results carry greater weight: supply below 90% doubles criticism from supporters and strengthens the opposition; recovery gains more support. Legitimacy also responds.
mandat.zivil.text: Civilian demand takes priority from approval until the programme ends. Fronts receive less fuel during shortages. The course stays binding, including preparation.
mandat.einsatz.text: During war or ceasefire: fronts take priority from approval until the programme ends. Civilian shortages may worsen. This does not guarantee goods can actually reach them.
mandat.bilanz.erfolg: Supply is recovering: supporting factions gain confidence in the programme. Agreed oversight strengthens this support.
mandat.bilanz.kritik: Civilian demand coverage is below 90%. Supporters lose confidence; the opposition demands accountability through a parliamentary question and gains strength.
mandat.bilanz.neutral: The majority awaits measurable results. This month’s supply results produce no additional change in faction willingness.
mandat.grundpaket: The effects below describe the base package. Agreed clauses and final terms are listed further down.
mandat.folgen: When passed, a fulfilled demand adds 3 willingness points and also loyalty for coalition partners. Overruled partners whose condition is absent lose 4 points; other unaccommodated factions lose 1. Failure costs coalition partners 2 points. Falling loyalty can cause a coalition breakup through the existing government system.
mandat.buendnisMehrheit: This majority needs votes outside the coalition.
mandat.mehrheitOffen: The package still needs a compromise.
mandat.koalitionsPreis: {parteien}: conditions remain unmet. Passing the package without concessions costs these partners loyalty, even if the vote succeeds.
mandat.koalitionBeruecksichtigt: Coalition partners’ conditions are included in the package.
mandat.kompromissKurz: See how votes and terms change before choosing. The forecast reflects the current political situation.
mandat.programmWirkung: Effects on the economy, society and foreign relations
mandat.oppositionDelta: Opposition strength: {n} points from the supply results.
mandat.sozial.kurz: Relieve households by taking on more debt.
mandat.haushalt.kurz: Spend less, but end support earlier.
mandat.kontrolle.kurz: Accept oversight; success and failure carry greater political weight.
mandat.zivil.kurz: Civilians first, even if fronts then lack fuel.
mandat.einsatz.kurz: Fronts first; civilian shortages may worsen.
mandat.verbrauchtesKapital: Spent: {pk} political capital including talks, after refunds.
mandat.hindernis.diplomatie: Resolve sanctions, trade bans or the conflict with the supplier country. Alternatively, you can withdraw the proposal.
mandat.hindernis.vertrauen: Improve relations with the supplier country to at least 40 trust, or withdraw the proposal.
mandat.hindernis.kurs: Remove the conflicting supply guarantee from the draft. The existing binding policy remains in force.
mandat.hindernis.einsatz: Remove the operational supply guarantee from the draft. Each amendment leaves at least three more days of debate.
mandat.hindernis.netz: There is currently no damaged route that can safely be repaired under this mandate. You can withdraw the proposal.
mandat.hindernis.allgemein: Resolve the missing prerequisite before the vote, or withdraw the proposal.
mandat.hindernis.folge: If the obstacle remains on {datum}, no mandate can take effect even with a majority. No budget funds will be released; political capital already spent remains spent.
mandat.hindernis.damals: Reason on the scheduled voting day: {grund}
mandat.prognoseStichtag: Forecast for the vote on {datum}: known confidence-and-supply expiry dates are included. All other political conditions reflect today’s situation.
mandat.duldungEndet: Support agreement expires before the vote
mandat.duldungFrist: The confidence-and-supply agreement with {parteien} expires by the planned vote. This forecast already excludes its support bonus. Secure other support or negotiate a new agreement after expiry.
mandat.zeitplanVorschau: If approved: ready no earlier than {ab}, running until {bis}. Deliveries and repairs take effect at monthly settlement.
mandat.zeitplanBeschlossen: Approved schedule: ready no earlier than {ab}, running until {bis}. Deliveries and repairs are settled monthly.
mandat.duldungDurchAenderung: The delay means the support agreement with {parteien} expires before the vote. The lost votes are included above.
mandat.bruch.titel: Secure the coalition before the vote
mandat.bruch.vorher: Departure is already possible on {datum}, before the vote: current support is below {grenze}. The forecast votes assume you keep this partner in the coalition.
mandat.bruch.gleich: The vote and monthly check both fall on {datum}. Below {grenze} loyalty, the party may leave during the same daily update; there is no opportunity for talks in between.
mandat.bruch.spaeter: Support would fall below {grenze} after the vote. The next monthly check is on {datum}; the partner needs more loyalty by then.
mandat.bruch.annahme: Loyalty after the expected approval, under current political conditions:
mandat.bruch.ablehnung: Loyalty after the expected rejection, under current political conditions:
mandat.bruch.handeln: Speak to the party leader beforehand or choose a less damaging compromise. Other monthly effects may also change support.
mandat.bruch.gespraech: Speak to the party leader in your circle
